policy.name: strict_cleanup_overwrite_v2
policy.dedupe: For duplicate question_id values, keep the row with better audit status, then higher score, then earlier original index.
policy.keep: Only keep the deduplicated row when audit status is 通过 and it has no placeholder/template or formula_incomplete risk.
